audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1, 2 and 3 disagreed with packet.levelChart (Skill/Skill/Skill/Zaahen/Skill/Poppy/Poppy) and with their own whys — whys[1] says level 2 stays even, whys[2] says level 3 is still a skill matchup, whys[3] says 4-5 is his window and to give ground.
audit.why: The chart gave Poppy levels 2 and 3 and called 4-5 even, directly against the text under it.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2 and 3 flipped as matched full+content pairs; the 4-5 rating dropped to match Zaahen owning it.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] has only 3 entries (packet defect) and none of them names an ability or a cooldown.
audit.why: Level 6, first item and 2+ items are covered; the fourth slot was empty on disk and has never been fillable.
audit.corrected: spikes[3] created with before:null — a late teamfight spike keyed to Keeper's Verdict at 100s and Steadfast Presence against Aureate Rush, so it reads in order after the 2+ items entry.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire page refers to 'Ultimate' as the tracked ability and names none of Zaahen's kit. Four applicable interactions were absent: Aureate Rush is a dash that Steadfast Presence grounds and it deals percent health; The Darkin Glaive opens on an auto-attack reset, heals him, and its recast knocks up; Dreaded Return pulls, which cancels Poppy's Keeper's Verdict channel; and his passive lets him revive at full Determination.
audit.why: 'Track Ultimate' is not actionable, and the revive changes every all-in maths decision in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Ability names and cooldowns (Q 10s, W 14s, E 10s, R 110s) now carry the advice; the pull-cancels-channel and revive facts are stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization mentioned no anti-heal even though both his Q and his R heal off damage dealt.
audit.why: Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades against a champion with two healing abilities and a revive passive.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal added to the itemization line.

edits.before: W deletes his dash mid-flight — hold it like a parry. Only take the trade when Zaahen's Ultimate is down.
edits.after: Level 2 stays even — neither of you has a real kill threat yet, so keep it clean and hold W for his dash.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Zaahen must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Still even at 3 — his damage spike has not arrived yet and your combo needs a wall, so set that angle up before you trade.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ultimate's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His window: The Darkin Glaive and Aureate Rush out-damage a squishy Poppy in extended trades — give ground and farm instead.

edits.before: New-champ respect — E-wall-stun his combo, out-trade. Poppy wins the Ultimate cooldown windows.
edits.after: W grounds Aureate Rush, anti-heal his Q and R, then E-wall-stun. Mind his Determination revive.

edits.before: Wall-stun his combo and out-trade. Track Ultimate before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Wall-stun his combo and out-trade. Track Grim Deliverance (110s) and ground Aureate Rush with W.

edits.before: E Zaahen into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: E him into a wall while Aureate Rush (10s) is spent, Q the zone under him, and W that dash the moment he uses it to close.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: Brawling through his Q recast — it knocks you up and heals him back through the trade.

edits.before: His big cooldown. Trade around it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Grim Deliverance is 110s at rank 1 and heals him — commit while it is down.

edits.before: E Zaahen into a wall when his answer is down, Q the zone under him, and W any dash he tries — his mobility is a suggestion.
edits.after: The Darkin Glaive opens on an auto reset and its recast knocks you up — step back on the wind-up, not the cast, and buy anti-heal.

edits.before: Zaahen wastes Ultimate — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Aureate Rush is his dash — W grounds it and the percent-HP hit.

edits.before: That is Zaahen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Dreaded Return pulls you in and cancels your R channel — never ult into it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Determination fills and he revives — check his stacks first.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: W spent early leaves Aureate Rush free, and its damage scales off your maximum health.

edits.before: Track Zaahen's Ultimate: His big cooldown. Trade around it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Aureate Rush is his dash — W grounds it. Dreaded Return's pull cancels your R channel.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (the slow engine), then Thornmail / Frozen Heart; boots Plated Steelcaps.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet (the slow engine), then Thornmail early for anti-heal — his Q and R both heal off you.
Late teamfights are yours: Keeper's Verdict (100s at rank 3) knocks him out of Grim Deliverance's heal, and Steadfast Presence grounds Aureate Rush before he reaches your carry.
